# Design Gurus

> > Design Gurus is a comprehensive platform for mastering technical interviews through structured courses, curated problem sets, and expert resources for coding and system design preparation.

Design Gurus offers interactive courses and learning resources focused on interview preparation for FAANG companies and top tech firms. The platform features flagship courses like Grokking the System Design Interview and Grokking the Coding Interview, alongside company-specific guides, Q&A hubs, and expert blog content.

## Key Topics

- System Design Interview
- Coding Interview Patterns
- FAANG Interviews
- Interview Preparation
- Behavioral Interviews
- Data Structures
- Coding Interview Prep
- Mock Interviews
- System Design Fundamentals
- Company Interview Guides
- Software Engineering
- Grokking Courses
- Problem-Solving Patterns
- Technical Interview Tips

## Flagship Courses

- [Grokking the System Design Interview](https://www.designgurus.io/course/grokking-the-system-design-interview): Original system design interview course by Design Gurus with 440K+ learners.
- [Grokking the Coding Interview: Patterns for Coding Questions](https://www.designgurus.io/course/grokking-the-coding-interview): Master 28 coding patterns with 500+ practice problems in Grokking the Coding Interview.
- [Grokking System Design Fundamentals](https://www.designgurus.io/course/grokking-system-design-fundamentals): Foundational system design course covering scalability, latency, caching, and architecture.
- [All Courses](https://www.designgurus.io/courses): Catalog of Design Gurus courses covering system design, coding patterns, and interview prep.

## Interview Preparation Resources

- [Interview Preparation Guide](https://www.designgurus.io/learn/interview-preparation-guide): Comprehensive guide for tech interview preparation covering coding, system design, behavioral interviews.
- [Company Interview Guides](https://www.designgurus.io/company-guides): Company-specific interview guides for Google, Amazon, Facebook, Microsoft, Oracle.
- [Blind 75 Coding Questions](https://www.designgurus.io/blind75): Curated list of 75 essential coding interview problems with detailed solutions.
- [Tech Interview Answers Q&A Hub](https://www.designgurus.io/answers): Q&A hub with expert answers to coding, system design, and behavioral interview questions.

## Learning & Community

- [Design Gurus Blog](https://www.designgurus.io/blog): Expert articles on system design, coding patterns, and behavioral interview strategies.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.designgurus.io/kb): Knowledge base and curated blog for system design, coding, and technical interview topics.
- [Newsletter](https://www.designgurus.io/newsletter): Free weekly newsletter with system design, coding interview tips, and interview trends.
